description: Calendar invite (.ics) generator — Builds a standards-compliant iCalendar (.ics) event from query parameters: timed or all-day, IANA time zone converted to UTC, end or duration, location, description, URL, recurrence rule and reminder alarm. Returns the .ics text plus a Google Calendar add link, or the raw text/calendar file with format=ics. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
